summary: Evogene Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing an at-the-market offering (ATM) through A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners for up to $2,926,500 of its ordinary shares under an existing F-3 shelf. The agent will use commercially reasonable efforts to sell shares on Nasdaq or in negotiated transactions, earning a 3% cash commission. This is a routine equity distribution facility, not a transformative special situation. No premium, fixed price, or structural catalyst is present. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown mechanism with no activist, M&A, or restructuring elements.
